test_title: PYST 29: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'TERRAIN' is written as 'VETTAIP' and 'TRAFFIC' is written as 'VTAHHIE'. How will 'MOTOR' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Consonants + 2; and Vowels are the same.**

'TERRAIN' is written as 'VETTAIP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/295b1cd4f3025f136f619b640db314eff79c06820c09baf6addc7fa74f87f4a3.png] 

'TRAFFIC' is written as 'VTAHHIE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14f152ae96a3332cb3d2cd7bdcc1f54e85447fc9510c7762f360dd478fbb8917.png] 

Similarly, '**MOTOR**' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b80294839ce01683022bb6625b3dbbcc89964dab96df404788b5e9a9c95fc02.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**OOVOT**".
